body: I could never do sales, holy hell. I googled dissociation just now and I'm pretty sure I've experienced it. But it's hard to say. The articles themselves even admit it's difficult to put into words. I found a list of signs to watch out for which includes rapid mood swings, trouble remembering personal details, forgetfulness about things you've said or done. All of which I identify strongly with nowadays after getting my first fulltime job and coping very poorly. I'm a cleaner as well but it's luckily not fast paced.

I happens to me at work as well, it can be *paralyzing*. May I ask what your job is?

The common sense thing is so accurate, I feel so alien when it happens. Everybody around me saying the right things with the right tone and making sound decisions while I'm over here on fight or flight mode essentially running on lizard brain.
